# 1 Clement Chapter 11 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalence)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 11 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_011_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 11

**11:1** Because of his hospitality and devotion to God, Lot was rescued from Sodom while the entire surrounding region was condemned to fire and sulfur. Through this God made it unmistakably clear: he does not abandon those who trust in him, but those who turn away from him are handed over to punishment and suffering. [Gen 19]

**11:2** His wife was left behind as a sobering sign. She was not aligned with Lot in heart or purpose, so she became a pillar of salt — and remains one to this day. It is a warning for all generations: those who waver in their commitment and doubt God's power will face his judgment and become an example that all can see. [Gen 19:26]

---

*PNEUMA renders for vivid application; "a sobering sign" captures the function of Lot's wife.*
